g.text: Objective: name the company's story type with the first rule that matches, then let the override file replace it or, for hypergrowth, supply the story file.

text.tspan: the classifier has named a story type
first match wins, in this order
hypergrowth
distressed
cyclical
high-growth
mature-decline
mature-stable

g.text: Gap: Altman Z is read by the classifier but computed nowhere, and analyze never passes it; only interest coverage can make a company distressed.

text.tspan: Comes out:
the story type the assumptions will follow, and the classifier's own type for the report
the classifier says hypergrowth [revenue growth at least 50% last year, compound annual growth rate (CAGR) at least 40%, operating margin below the sector's, founded at most 15 years ago or unknown]
founded age = this year − founded_year of the override file, not ipo_date (ipo_date still feeds the high-growth age)
the classifier says distressed [interest coverage at most 1.0]
or Altman Z < 1.81, which analyze never supplies

g.text: not distressed [interest coverage above 1.0 or unknown]

text.tspan: the classifier says cyclical [cyclical sector and earnings variation at least 0.50]
coefficient of variation = standard deviation ÷ |mean| of net income
(population standard deviation; fewer than two years or mean 0: not cyclical)
the classifier says high-growth [revenue growth at least 15% a year and age at most 25 years or unknown]
revenue compound annual growth rate (CAGR)
CAGR = (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1
unknown age counts as young
fewer than two years, or first or last ≤ 0: mature-stable
the classifier says mature-decline [revenue growth at most −1% a year]
CAGR ≤ −1%

g.text: the classifier says mature-stable [every other company]
the classifier's story type stands [no story type in the override file, and not hypergrowth]
the override file's story type replaces it [a story type other than hypergrowth in the file; an unknown label drives no branch]
the story type falls back to high-growth [the classifier says hypergrowth, the file sets no story type and has no story section]

text.tspan: the story type is hypergrowth [a story section and story type hypergrowth in the override file]
the story file is the story section of the override file

g.text: story_type key, read with every other override
the sector row is found [its region's, else another region's]
no sector row [industry absent from every region]
the story type goes on to the assumptions [always]
